reason: I travel twice a month and a pre-counted evening dose that goes in a bag is actually handy, and $24.99 with an empty-box refund is an easy impulse buy. The named lab report on the box helps too.
objection: 30 foil sachets a month is a lot of packaging waste for something I could take from a bottle.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a creator video where the sachet actually solves a travel or sleep problem I have would make it an easy yes; a higher price after the launch box would make me stop at one.
